programs.name: Enterprise Discount Program (EDP)
programs.description: Customers commit to cloud spend and get discounts. Red Hat marketplace purchases count toward EDP commitments 1:1.

programs.name: Migration Acceleration Program (MAP)
programs.description: AWS funding to offset costs of migrating workloads. Includes assessment credits and migration tooling.

programs.name: AWS Co-Sell
programs.description: Joint selling motion with AWS field sales. Begin with an AWS co-sell opportunity in ACE portal.

programs.name: Channel Partner Private Offer (CPPO)
programs.description: Red Hat solutions available through distribution partners on AWS Marketplace.

programs.name: AWS Marketplace Credit Incentive
programs.description: Promotional credits for customers purchasing through AWS Marketplace.

programs.name: Distribution Channel Private Offer (DCPO)
programs.description: Red Hat solutions available through distribution partners: Arrow, Carahsoft, Ingram Micro, TD Synnex.

programs.name: Marketplace Customer Private Offer (MCPO)
programs.description: Direct private offers to customers on Google Cloud Marketplace.

programs.name: Google Cloud Commit
programs.description: Red Hat marketplace purchases burn down customer's Google Cloud committed spend.

programs.name: Marketplace Azure Acceleration Program (MAAP)
programs.description: Incentives for transacting Red Hat solutions through Azure Marketplace.

programs.name: Azure Sponsorship for POC
programs.description: Up to $400K in free Azure credits for qualified partners and customers for deployment and POC.

programs.name: Azure Consumption Commitment (MACC)
programs.description: Red Hat marketplace purchases count toward customer's Microsoft Azure Consumption Commitment.
